post.description: Authenticates with login (phone, email, or username) + password. Returns an access token in the body and sets an httpOnly refresh cookie. Rate-limited to 5/min/IP.

Exchanges the httpOnly refresh cookie for a new access token and rotates the cookie. The browser client must call this with credentials: 'include' — a cross-origin request that drops the cookie is the usual cause of an unexplained 401 here.
Invalidates the refresh session server-side and clears the refresh cookie.
Requires the current password. No special permission beyond being logged in.

Always returns success regardless of whether the login exists, to avoid leaking which accounts are real. If it exists and has an active Telegram binding, a 1-hour reset token is sent there; otherwise nothing is delivered and the request is a silent no-op.

post.summary: Reset a password with a token
post.description: Completes the flow started by /forgot-password using the token it delivered.

get.description: Returns the logged-in user's profile, roles, branch scope, effective permissions, and the tenant's permissionsVersion (bump this to force clients to refetch after an RBAC change).

post.description: Not meant to be called directly — Telegram itself POSTs updates here when TELEGRAM_MODE=webhook. Verifies X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token in constant time and rejects with 400 if it doesn't match. Always acknowledges with 200 even on internal processing errors, since Telegram retries anything but a 200 — failures are logged server-side instead of surfaced to the caller.

post.summary: Create a Telegram invite for a guardian
post.description: Generates a one-time deep link (expires in 72h) the guardian opens in Telegram to bind their account, so they can receive notifications (payment reminders, announcements, etc).

get.description: Every guardian/staff Telegram account currently bound for this tenant.

get.summary: List guardians not yet bound to Telegram
get.description: The single best predictor of whether the notification feature is actually working for this tenant (per 05-telegram-spec.md §8.1) — guardians here won't receive anything sent over Telegram until they use an invite link.
Filterable by entity type/ID, user, action, and date range. Paginated (limit capped at 200). Read-only and append-only — there are no write endpoints for the audit log. Requires audit:read.

get.summary: Get an audit log entry by ID

get.description: Read-only view of the code-owned permission catalog — every permission key that exists, the scopes it supports, and whether it's marked sensitive. Permissions themselves cannot be created via the API (see class comment); this is what role-editing UIs list from.
The distinct group names permissions are organized under (e.g. "children").
Public, unauthenticated. Confirms the database is reachable (SELECT 1) and returns 503 STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE otherwise. Used by the CI/CD smoke test and can be pointed at by an uptime monitor.
Set includeSystem=true to include built-in system roles alongside custom ones.
Every role crossed with every permission — the data behind a role-editor grid UI.

patch.description: Cannot rename/modify the protected Owner role (01-stage1-plan.md §5.5).

delete.description: Blocked for the protected Owner role and for any role still assigned to a user — the §5.5 safety rails (RbacSafetyService) exist specifically to prevent an accidental lockout.

get.description: Every user currently assigned this role.
Compares role :id's permission grants against another role (?against=).

post.description: Creates a new role with the same permission grants as an existing one.

put.description: Full replace of the role's permission grants. Enforces the §5.5 safety rails: you cannot grant a permission you don't hold yourself (privilege escalation), and a change that would leave you locked out of managing roles is rejected (403 SELF_LOCKOUT) rather than applied.

post.summary: Grant one permission to a role
post.description: Same privilege-escalation and self-lockout rules as PUT /:id/permissions, for a single grant.

delete.summary: Revoke one permission from a role
delete.description: Rejected with 403 SELF_LOCKOUT if it would leave you unable to manage roles.

get.description: Filterable by status and branch.

post.description: Deactivating your own account, or the last active Owner, is rejected — see the §5.5 safety rails.

post.summary: Assign a role to a user
post.description: Enforces the §5.5 safety rails: you cannot assign a role that grants permissions you don't hold yourself (privilege escalation).

put.description: Full replace of dto.roles. Same privilege-escalation check as assign, plus a last-owner check — the tenant's final active Owner cannot have that role replaced away.

delete.summary: Remove a role from a user
delete.description: Optionally scoped to one branchId. Same last-owner protection as PUT /:id/roles.

get.description: The fully resolved permission set after combining roles and per-user overrides.
Per-user grants/revokes layered on top of their roles.

post.summary: Set a permission override for a user
post.description: Grants or revokes a single permission for this user specifically, on top of whatever their roles already give them. Same privilege-escalation rule as role assignment applies.

get.description: The single settings row for this tenant (timezone, language, currency, etc).
Filterable by year and branch. Used to exclude non-working days from billing.

post.description: dto.isWorking marks an exception day that IS a working day despite the calendar (e.g. a makeup day).
Stage 1 is single-branch in practice, but the schema supports more than one.

get.description: Paginated, filterable by status, groupId, and free-text search (q). Requires child:read; results are scoped to the caller's branch/group depending on their granted scope.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches first, last, or middle name

post.description: Registers a new child record. Requires child:create.

201.description: The new child is created with status `applicant` — it is NOT on any attendance screen until POST /children/:id/status moves it to `active` and it is assigned to a group.

get.description: Returns full profile detail for a single child. Requires child:read.

patch.description: Updates a child's profile fields. Requires child:update.

delete.description: Permanently removes a child record. Requires child:delete, a sensitive permission — see the RBAC §5.5 safety rails (privilege-escalation and sensitive-permission gating).

post.description: Transitions a child between statuses (e.g. active, graduated, withdrawn) and records the transition in the status history. Setting status to withdrawn or graduated stamps the withdrawal date from dto.effectiveDate. Requires child:status.

get.description: Returns the full status-change history for a child. Requires child:read.
Returns metadata for every document on file for this child. Requires child:read.

post.summary: Add a document to a child's file
post.description: Attaches a document record (e.g. a scanned ID or medical form) to a child. Requires child:update. The document itself is uploaded separately via the files module.

patch.description: Edits an existing document record for this child. Requires child:update.

post.description: Marks a document as staff-verified (e.g. an ID checked against the original). Requires child:update.

get.description: Requires medical:read — a separate permission from general child:read.

put.description: Full replace (PUT, not PATCH) of medical data — allergies, conditions, medications, etc. Requires medical:write.

get.description: Returns the short list of critical medical flags (e.g. severe allergies) meant for staff to see at a glance, separate from the full medical record. Requires medical:alerts.
Returns recorded parental consents (e.g. photo/media release, field trips) for this child. Requires consent:read.

post.description: Records a new parental consent for this child. Requires consent:manage.
Revokes a previously recorded consent. Requires consent:manage.

get.description: Cross-child view of documents (e.g. medical certificates, contracts) expiring within the given window (default 30 days). Requires child:read.
Searchable by free-text query (q) or phone number. Requires guardian:read.

post.description: Registers a new guardian record. Requires guardian:manage.

patch.description: Updates a guardian's own profile fields. Requires guardian:manage.

get.description: Returns every child linked to this guardian, across all their links.
Returns guardians linked to this child, with each link's relationship/access details. Requires child:read.

post.summary: Link a guardian to a child
post.description: Creates a new child–guardian relationship. Requires guardian:manage.

patch.description: Edits an existing child–guardian link's relationship/access details (not the guardian's own profile — see PATCH /guardians/:id for that). Requires guardian:manage.

delete.summary: Unlink a guardian from a child
delete.description: Removes the child–guardian relationship (the guardian record itself is untouched). Requires guardian:manage.

get.description: Filterable by branchId and status. Requires group:read.

post.description: Requires group:manage.

patch.description: Updates a group's own fields (name, capacity, etc). Requires group:manage.

get.description: Returns children currently assigned to this group. Requires group:read.

post.summary: Assign a child to a group
post.description: Closes out the child's current group assignment (if any) and opens a new one in this group from dto.effectiveDate. Rejected with CAPACITY_EXCEEDED if the group is full unless ?force=true — and force=true itself requires the group:capacity_override permission on top of group:manage.

post.summary: Transfer a child to another group
post.description: Same capacity check and force/group:capacity_override rule as assign — the destination group is dto.toGroupId, not the :id in the URL (which is informational only).

put.description: Full replace (PUT) of the group's assigned staff list. Requires group:manage.

get.description: Every child assignment ever made to this group, most recent first.

Filterable by groupId/branchId. Requires attendance:read. Returns only children who already have a row for today — it is NOT the roster. To build a morning board, list the roster from GET /children?status=active&groupId=… and merge these rows onto it by childId.
Children who have checked in but not yet checked out, right now.
Children with no check-in for the given date (defaults to today).

get.summary: List children not yet picked up
get.description: Children still checked in past their expected pickup time.
One month of daily attendance status for a single child.
Aggregated attendance stats for a group over a date range (from/to).
Audit trail of manually corrected attendance records, filterable by date range and the user who made the correction. Requires attendance:correct.
Filterable by date, date range, group, child, and status.

post.description: Records a check-in event for the current day. Requires attendance:checkin.
Records a check-out event, pairing with the open check-in. Requires attendance:checkout.
Sets a child's attendance status (e.g. marking a planned absence) without going through a physical check-in/check-out. Requires attendance:checkin.
Amends a past attendance record after the fact. Uses the separate attendance:correct permission rather than checkin/checkout, and is what shows up in GET /corrections.

Rate-limited to 20/min/tenant (not per-user, unlike most other endpoints). Requires an Idempotency-Key header for contract consistency with the other mutating endpoints — the real dedup guarantee comes from NotificationsService's own dedup_key, not this header.

get.description: Filterable by recipient, channel, status, and date range.

put.description: Upsert by key (PUT, not POST) — the same key always refers to the same template.

post.description: Renders the template with dto.sampleData substituted in, without sending anything.

get.description: Filterable by branch. Includes drafts — see status on each row.

post.description: Created as a draft — nothing is sent until POST /:id/publish.
Sends the announcement to its intended recipients via the notification pipeline.

get.summary: List a child's authorized pickup persons
get.description: The standing list — not the same as who is currently active, see the pickup-permissions endpoints for that. Requires pickup:read.

post.description: Adds someone to a child's standing pickup-authorization list. Requires pickup:manage.

delete.description: Deletes the record outright. To keep a paper trail instead, use revoke below.

post.description: Revokes authorization without deleting the record, keeping dto.reason on file — the auditable alternative to DELETE.

get.description: Who is currently authorized to pick up a given child on the given date (defaults to today) — the standing list plus any temporary grants in effect.

post.description: One-off authorization for someone not on the standing pickup-persons list. Requires the separate pickup:temporary permission.

get.description: Every recorded pickup event for this child.

get.summary: Verify a pickup person at the door
get.description: The fast, single-purpose lookup reception uses at pickup time to confirm a given person is currently authorized for a given child. Requires pickup:read; see the code comment on this handler for why it skips the usual tenant-scoped record lookup other endpoints use.
Filterable by active status.

post.summary: Assign a tariff to a child
Grant a discount to a child
post.description: Requires discount:manage. Applies going forward — see billing rules for stacking behavior.

delete.description: Revokes a previously granted discount. Requires discount:manage.

get.description: Filterable by year.

post.description: Locks the period against further charge generation. Requires period:close.
Requires period:reopen — a sensitive permission deliberately excluded from most roles' default grants (see prisma/seed.ts), since reopening a closed financial period should be rare and auditable.

get.description: Every versioned billing-rules document ever published, per 03-billing-rules.md.

post.summary: Publish a new billing rules version
post.description: Creates a new versioned billing-rules document, effective from dto.effectiveFrom. Does not retroactively touch charges already generated under an earlier version.

get.description: The billing-rules version in effect on the given date (defaults to today).

get.summary: Get a billing rules version by ID

get.description: Compares version :id against another version (?against=) to show what changed.

post.description: Dry-runs what a child would be charged for dto.year/dto.month, under either the currently active rules or a draft passed in dto.rules — without creating any real charge. Useful for previewing a rules change before publishing it.
Computes what charges a run for dto.year/dto.month would generate, without writing anything to the ledger. Nothing is real until POST /:id/commit.

get.summary: Get a billing run by ID

delete.description: Discards a previewed (not yet committed) run. Nothing was written, so nothing to reverse.

get.summary: Explain one child's charge within a billing run
get.description: Breaks down how this child's charge was computed — tariff, discounts, proration.

post.description: Writes the previewed charges to the ledger. Requires an Idempotency-Key header — retrying the same key returns the original result instead of double-billing.

get.description: Filterable by child, period, kind, and unpaid-only.

post.description: Adds a one-off charge outside the normal billing-run flow (e.g. a fee or adjustment). Requires charge:generate.
Reverses a charge rather than deleting it, preserving the append-only ledger (see 06-ops-reference.md §3). Requires dto.reason and the separate charge:reverse permission.

get.description: Filterable by child, date range, payment method, and who recorded it.

post.description: Records a payment and allocates it against outstanding charges. Requires an Idempotency-Key header — retrying the same key returns the original result instead of double-recording the payment.
Cancels a recorded payment and reverses its allocations, rather than deleting it — preserves the append-only ledger. Requires dto.reason and the separate payment:cancel permission.

get.description: Returns an HTML receipt by default; pass ?format=pdf for a downloadable PDF.
Aggregated outstanding-debt totals across the tenant.
Filterable by group, overdue-only, and a minimum amount — minAmountTiyin is in tiyin (1/100 of the display currency unit), matching how amounts are represented across this API.

get.summary: Get an expense summary for a year

get.description: Filterable by year, month, type, and status.

post.description: Requires expense:manage. Recorded as unpaid until POST /:id/pay.

Multipart upload, field name "file". Optionally tagged to an entity via entityType/entityId query params. Stored via the local or S3/MinIO driver depending on STORAGE_DRIVER — callers never see which. Requires file:manage.

get.description: Streams the file's bytes directly — files are never exposed via a presigned URL, so access control is enforced on every download, not just at upload time. Requires file:read.
Attendance for a single date, optionally filtered by group. Format: json/xlsx/pdf.
Attendance rolled up for a year/month, optionally filtered by group.
Manual attendance corrections over a date range — the reporting view of GET /attendance/corrections.
Currently active children, optionally filtered by group.
Children enrolled within a date range.
The reporting view of GET /documents/expiring, exportable as xlsx/pdf.
Every active medical alert across all children, exportable as xlsx/pdf.
Charges for a billing period.
Payments over a date range, optionally filtered by method.
Outstanding debts; set ageing=true (or "overdue") to restrict to overdue-only.
Discounts granted over a date range.
Cancelled payments/charges (reversals) over a date range.

get.summary: Get an export job by ID
get.description: Poll this for the job a report endpoint returned 202 for (large xlsx/pdf exports run async — see the reports module). Once ready, the job carries a download link/status.
Cross-domain overview (enrollment, attendance, finance) scoped to the caller.
Finance-focused overview: billing, payments, debts.
Day-to-day operational view: today's attendance, pickups, alerts.
Returns a blank .xlsx template for the given entity (e.g. "children") to fill in and re-upload.

post.description: Uploads a spreadsheet (multipart, field "file") for the given ?entity= and validates it row by row without writing anything — creates an import job whose ID is passed to POST /commit to actually apply it.
Applies a previously validated import job (dto.importJobId). Set dto.skipInvalid to true to import only the rows that passed validation rather than rejecting the whole file.

get.summary: Get an import job by ID

get.description: Blocks in display order with every locale intact, plus SEO, the published version and whether the draft has changes not yet published. Doubles as the editor preview — this is the authenticated view of exactly what publishing would make live.

get.summary: List the available block types and their content schemas
get.description: The section catalog, straight from code (src/landing/block-content.ts). The admin UI renders its per-block form from this rather than hardcoding field lists, so a section type added on the server shows up in the editor without a frontend release.

post.summary: Add a block to the landing page

put.description: Send every block with its new position — applied in one transaction.
Content is validated against the block's existing type; `type` itself is immutable.

delete.description: Removes it from the draft only — the live page keeps the block until the next publish.

put.summary: Update page SEO / social preview metadata

post.description: Freezes the visible blocks into the snapshot the public endpoint serves and appends a version. Requires landing:publish — a content editor with only landing:manage can prepare changes but not push them live.

get.summary: Get one published version, including its full snapshot

post.description: Replays that snapshot over the draft and publishes it as a new version — history stays append-only, so the restore is itself undoable.

get.summary: Get the published landing page for the default tenant (public, no auth)
get.description: Same payload as GET /public/landing/{tenantCode}, for single-kindergarten deployments where the marketing site should not have to know a tenant code. 404 unless LANDING_DEFAULT_TENANT_CODE is set. Declared before the :tenantCode route so the bare path is not read as a code.

get.summary: Get the published landing page (public, no auth)
get.description: The live marketing content for one kindergarten, flattened to a single language. Serves the published snapshot only — drafts are never visible here. 404 until the page has been published at least once. Responds with an ETag; send If-None-Match to get a 304, since this changes only when someone publishes.

get.summary: Get an image used by the published landing page (public, no auth)
get.description: Serves a file only while some published block still references it — access is derived from the live content, not from a flag, so republishing without an image revokes it. Images only; every other file in the tenant stays behind GET /files/:id and file:read.

key.description: Permission key from the code catalog, e.g. child:read

code.description: Short machine code, unique per tenant, e.g. senior_teacher

password.description: Initial password, set by the admin creating this account

branchIds.description: Branches this user has access to
Replaces the branches this user can see. Role grants move with them: dropping a branch drops the role rows on it, adding one re-grants every role the user already holds.

branchId.description: Branch to scope this grant to. Omit to grant across every branch the user currently has access to (see user_role.branch_id note in roles.service.ts / README).

status.description: A child created via POST /children starts as `applicant` — it must be moved to `active` before it appears on attendance screens.

groupId.description: Current group (group_assignment with effectiveTo = null); null if unassigned.

isPayer.description: Receives invoices and is chased for debt

status.description: A child created via POST /children starts as `applicant` — it must be moved to `active` before it appears on attendance screens.

groupId.description: Current group (group_assignment with effectiveTo = null); null if unassigned.

fullName.description: Staff DO have fullName — children do not

billable.description: Whether this day counts toward billing

child.description: The child — names live HERE, not on the row

pickupPersonId.description: Person picking up the child. Validated against pickup permissions once the pickup module exists — currently recorded but not yet permission-checked (see attendance.service.ts).

reason.description: Minimum 10 characters — enforced by the DB too

sampleData.description: Sample values for every {var} the template declares

fullName.description: For a one-off person not stored as a pickup person

amountTiyin.description: Integer tiyin as a string, e.g. "150000000"

value.description: For kind=fixed: integer tiyin as a string. For kind=percent: basis points (1000 = 10%).

rules.description: Override rules for the simulation, otherwise the active version is used

amountTiyin.description: Integer tiyin as a string — always positive; use a negative percent/fixed discount or /charges/:id/reverse for reductions

allocations.description: Omit to auto-allocate FIFO, oldest open charge first

content.description: Shape depends on `type` — see GET /landing/block-types for each schema.

position.description: Defaults to the end of the page.
